rationale: A is incomplete, but it at least gives a direct recommendation aligned to the actual choice set and some implementation guidance (central core plus embedded liaisons). B looks more structured, but it recommends an added option outside the original framing and provides little real reasoning for why it beats embedded, centralized, or hybrid in this scenario. Its quantitative material is mostly KPI definitions, not decision-supporting evidence. Neither handles uncertainty well or gives clear revisit triggers. A is more useful because a careful decision-maker could actually act on it, while B mostly reframes the problem without resolving it.
